title.en: Attentive caregivers with customer service dispute

text.en: Most dog owners praise individual team members and the owner for providing caring supervision and thorough facility tours. Nonetheless, one critical review highlights sharp dissatisfaction with front-desk interactions, citing rude customer communication.

Clients frequently compliment the clean and thoughtfully designed facility, highlighting specialized spaces like the Zen Den and observation areas. Owners also value the round-the-clock operating schedule, which offers essential flexibility for busy routines.

Reviewers emphasize the gentle introduction provided to puppies and first-time daycare visitors. Pet parents report feeling reassured by attentive staff who monitor canine play groups carefully and ensure younger dogs socialize safely without feeling overwhelmed.

q.en: Does the daycare facility operate 24 hours?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight the 24-hour daycare schedule as a major convenience for owners with demanding or irregular work hours.

q.en: Can new clients tour the boarding areas?

a.en: Yes, reviewers describe comprehensive facility tours where staff showcase the playrooms, observation areas, and quiet Zen Den.

q.en: Are young puppies accepted for daycare?

a.en: Pet owners report bringing five-month-old puppies for supervised daycare stays and gentle introductory socialization.
